title: 云原生网络后端迁移与 AI 安全协作简报
english: Kubernetes is scheduling removal of the kube-proxy ipvs backend. The project says ipvs was an experiment that improved performance over iptables, but the kernel IPVS API was a bad match for the Kubernetes Services API, and the backend never correctly implemented all Service edge cases. Kubernetes introduced the nftables backend in 1.29; it became GA in 1.33, with the plan that nftables would eventually replace both iptables and ipvs. Separately, OpenAI says it is working with NATO and allied cyber agencies so trusted defenders can find vulnerabilities, test fixes, and protect essential systems. OpenAI also expanded ChatGPT for Academic Researchers to 200,000 researchers worldwide with free access to frontier models.
chinese: 本期简报聚焦两条可核查动态：Kubernetes 计划移除 kube-proxy 的 ipvs 后端，原因是 IPVS 内核 API 与 Services API 匹配不佳，且该后端未能完整处理 Service 的边缘场景；nftables 后端在 1.29 引入、1.33 GA，目标是最终替代 iptables 与 ipvs。另一条是 OpenAI 与北约及盟国网络机构合作，帮助可信防御者发现漏洞、测试修复并保护关键系统；同时将 ChatGPT for Academic Researchers 扩展至全球 20 万名研究人员，提供前沿模型免费访问。
why_it_matters: 对资深运维开发而言，kube-proxy 后端迁移会直接影响集群网络升级、故障排查与监控策略；需要验证 Service 边缘场景并关注 nftables 路径。AI 安全协作则提示 AIOps 与 Agent Infra 应把 AI 辅助漏洞发现与修复测试纳入可审计、可控的工作流；职业上应同时积累云原生网络迁移经验与 AI 辅助运维治理能力。
interview_expression: I would frame the kube-proxy ipvs removal as a reminder to validate networking behavior against Kubernetes Service edge cases before upgrades. On the AI side, I would highlight AI-assisted vulnerability discovery as a controlled workflow for trusted defenders, not an unreviewed automation.

sources.title: Scheduling the removal of the kube-proxy IPVS backend
sources.summary:
The ipvs backend for kube-proxy was an experiment in providing a service proxy implementation with better performance than the iptables backend. While it succeeded in that goal, the kernel IPVS API has turned out to be a bad match for the Kubernetes Services API, and the ipvs backend was never able to implement all of the edge cases of Kubernetes Service functionality correctly.

In Kubernetes 1.29, the project introduced the nftables backend for kube-proxy, which became GA in 1.33. Part of the plan behind adding the nftables backend was the idea that it would eventually replace both the iptables and ipvs backends.
